name: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar
summary: At Dun Algaz, Mountaineer Rockgar is preparing an expedition into the Wetlands. Mountaineer Kadrell sends you north from Loch Modan to join him in the sodden lowlands along the pass between the dwarven homeland and the northern territories.

sections.title: The Road to the North Gate
sections.body: Dun Algaz cuts through the northern ridge between Loch Modan and the marshy Wetlands. Trade, messengers, and military detachments pass through this fortified route between Ironforge and Alliance settlements farther north. As tensions rise along the borders, Mountaineer Kadrell watches the road and seeks hardy volunteers for the northern outposts.

sections.title: A Mission Gone Awry
sections.body: Mountaineer Kadrell sends recruits expecting a routine scouting expedition. But at Dun Algaz, Mountaineer Rockgar prepares for active conflict, not a peaceful reconnaissance. Hostile forces choke the pass, and the scouting effort becomes a bitter struggle to secure the gauntlet.

faq.q: Who gives the order to report to Rockgar?
aliases: who starts report to mountaineer rockgar
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell gives the order. He is stationed in Thelsamar across the road from the Stoutlager Inn, watching the main road toward the mountain pass.

faq.q: Where can I find Mountaineer Rockgar?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Rockgar is stationed north along the road out of Loch Modan, guarding the entrance to the tunnels of Dun Algaz.

faq.q: Why is this mission through Dun Algaz so important?
faq.answer: Dun Algaz is the main overland corridor between Loch Modan and the Wetlands. Keeping it clear protects Alliance supplies and military messages, and keeps safe travel to Menethil Harbor and beyond.

faq.q: What happens after meeting Mountaineer Rockgar?
aliases: what comes after report to rockgar
faq.answer: Rockgar immediately enlists your help with The Algaz Gauntlet. The scouting expedition has become a bloody fight against hostile forces blocking the mountain tunnels.

faq.q: What level of adventurer should take on this assignment?
faq.answer: This assignment is for seasoned travelers around level twenty to twenty-one. They are finishing their duties in Loch Modan and preparing to brave the Wetlands.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde characters?
faq.answer: No. The Ironforge Mountaineers are loyal to King Magni Bronzebeard and the Alliance. Only Alliance travelers can accept the assignment.

angles.text: As a dwarf, answering fellow mountaineers helps keep the overland link between the Ironforge heartland and the dwarven holdings in the Wetlands.
As an Alliance traveler, helping secure Dun Algaz keeps the overland route to Menethil Harbor open. It is the Alliance's main western port in the Eastern Kingdoms.
